subject: VentureBank — Procurement next steps & PO timeline
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@venturebank.com>, Oliver Grant <o.grant@venturebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Sep 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: VentureBank — Procurement next steps & PO timeline

Hi Samantha / Oliver —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation and really positive alignment on the goals for merchant risk scoring and latency SLAs. Quick recap + proposed next steps: 

- Key decision criteria you mentioned: predictable per-token economics, private deployment option for PCI scope, and audit/log retention for 13 months.
- Stakeholder map you called out: Samantha (Procurement), Oliver (Security), and a final approval expected from VP of Engineering (TBD).
- Vendor onboarding items we need: completed onboarding form, SOC2 evidence (we can provide link), and PO terms.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll attach our vendor onboarding form and a draft SOW for your procurement team to review (attached).
2) Oliver — if you can confirm what evidence your security team needs beyond SOC2 (e.g., network diagrams, pen-test reports), we’ll gather and share.
3) Samantha — can you confirm the PO cadence (net 30 vs net 45) and whether you need our invoice remittance details to be on an internal vendor portal?
4) Suggested follow-up: 30-minute sync next Wed 9/8 to confirm timeline and next approver.

Attachments: VentureBank_Redwood_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@venturebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Oliver Grant <o.grant@venturebank.com>, Vendor Ops <vendor-ops@venturebank.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VentureBank — Procurement next steps & PO timeline

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A few notes from procurement: 

- We prefer net 45 on first-year vendor relationships; we can discuss shortening on renewal.
- Yes, we use an internal vendor portal (VendorOps). They will need the completed onboarding form plus W-9 and remit-to details. I copied Vendor Ops to start that intake.
- For approvals: Procurement (me) -> Security (Oliver) -> Legal (TBD) -> VP Eng sign-off. Estimated internal timeline ~3 weeks once form + SOC2 are provided.

Can you: 
1) Re-send onboarding form filled with Redwood remit info?
2) Share SOC2 link and a short summary of data residency/audit log retention?
3) Confirm if Redwood supports incoming PO numbers on invoices?

Thanks —
Samantha
Head of Procurement | VentureBank
samantha.lee@venturebank.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@venturebank.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Oliver Grant <o.grant@venturebank.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: VentureBank — Procurement next steps & PO timeline

Forwarding the completed onboarding form + SOW. See below and attachments. Answers inline: 

- Onboarding form: attached and completed (VentureBank_Redwood_Onboarding_Form.xlsx).
- SOC2: here is the public evidence portal link (https://redwoodinference.com/soc2) and short summary: we retain audit logs for 13 months by default; enterprise customers can configure longer retention on Dedicated/Private plans.
- PO numbers: yes, we support incoming PO numbers on invoices and can include them on the invoice PDF. We accept ACH and wire; remit-to details included on the onboarding form.

Proposed: keep 9/8 30-minute sync to confirm any additional evidence Oliver needs and confirm who will be listed as final approver. If that works, I can calendar invite.

Attachments: VentureBank_Redwood_Onboarding_Form.xlsx, Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
(415) 555-0123

From: Oliver Grant <o.grant@venturebank.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@venturebank.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2027 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: VentureBank — Procurement next steps & PO timeline

Marissa — thanks for the form and SOC2 link. For our security checklist, please also provide: 
- Network architecture diagram (high level)
- Penetration test summary or report (last 12 months)
- List of subcontractors and where data might be processed (if any)

I can fast-track once we have those items. If you can push those by EOD Friday 9/10 we should be able to meet the ~3 week procurement window Samantha noted.

Oliver
Senior Security Engineer | VentureBank

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>

Oliver/Samantha — great, we’ll get those over today. Quick internal notes so Dylan/Dev are aligned: 

- Action items for Redwood:
  * Dylan to attach high-level network architecture diagram and pen-test summary (redacted) by EOD 9/10.
  * Dev to prepare a short subcontractor list and processing locations.
  * Marissa to follow up with Vendor Ops Doc to confirm portal intake and requested W-9.

- Timeline expectation: if we deliver materials 9/10, VentureBank procurement projected close ~3 weeks (target the week of 10/1).

I’ll send the calendar invite for a 9/8 intake — and note for the record: PO terms (net 45) acknowledged.
